run_landsat_handler: run the landsat_handler function to import and parse the LandSat UCI satellite dataset from an artifacts path
review_landsat_handler: review the landsat_handler function that loads sat.trn and sat.tst files and returns dataset metadata and split generators
summarize_gen_function: summarize the inner gen function that yields PIL Image and label tuples from reshaped 3x3 satellite patches
build_landsat_dataset_config: build a DownloadableDataset config for landsat with UCI archive URLs and the landsat_handler function
test_landsat_splits: test the landsat dataset split generation that random splits training data and assigns the test file
